children: Australia’s Industry Index climbed to -3.5 in August 2026 from an upwardly revised -26.2 in the prior month, marking the highest reading since February.
The strong recovery was due to improved conditions in construction and business services, which both reported increased activity due to datacentre projects.

title: Australia Industry Conditions Rebound
